measurement.perfEventProbe: PERF_TYPE_HARDWARE instructions/cycles -> ENOENT in the exact broker eval container (linuxkit 6.10.14 VM kernel, root with CAP_SYS_ADMIN, paranoid=2); PERF_TYPE_SOFTWARE works but is not work-proportional; work-proportional cross-check therefore uses the trusted parent's wait4/getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) CPU accounting
measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max
measurement.scoring: reference-normalized: q = raw_q * 7385110.981771862 / reference_q with a pristine in-eval trusted-baseline build sampled interleaved with the candidate; each microbenchmark sample runs a trusted-composed randomized PROGRAM (structure, identifiers, constants; scored per-iteration op count preserved) streamed on stdin at clock-start with a fresh nonce and randomized input, its nonce-salted fold validated byte for byte against the reference on the identical streamed bytes; each leg reduced to the fastest (min) of 15 round-robin interleaved samples per binary; every candidate leg additionally passes the out-of-process CPU gates (cpu <= wall*1.15+0.02s single-threaded discipline per sample; kept-fastest CPU >= 0.4x reference per benchmark, bounding throttled classes to 2.5x); plus module startup (fastest 16 of 31 launches, median of 3 rounds, same per-launch discipline and 0.4x median kept-CPU floor); cancels ambient host-speed drift under sustained VM competitor load

perturbation.description: Inline float64/int remainder (OP_mod) fast path avoiding the no_inline js_binary_arith_slow call for the common float remainder that the per-iteration nonce fold performs on every trusted-composed program
